title: Electrical Troubleshooter
description: Guides users through a safety-first electrical decision tree for recording observations and choosing escalation paths. It translates practical diagnostic reasoning into a consistent, inspectable workflow.

title: Internet Time Machine
description: Turns network-quality history into provenance-aware trends and optional user-triggered summaries. It demonstrates clear data-source labeling and separates deterministic reporting from optional assistance.

title: Diploma Notes
description: Helps Kerala Diploma learners reach syllabus links, lesson material, notes, and question-paper resources from one organized study platform. It demonstrates information architecture and accessible static-web delivery for a focused student audience.

title: Digital Life Dashboard
description: Organizes browser-held notes, preferences, and personal insights in a local-first dashboard. It demonstrates responsive information design without requiring unnecessary collection of personal data.

title: System Change Tracker
description: Presents system changes as a read-only timeline with comparison views and explicit synthetic-data boundaries. It demonstrates audit-friendly reporting without implying hidden access to a visitor’s computer.

title: Question Machine
description: Provides a progressive learning tree with deterministic assessment and optional server-side semantic feedback. It demonstrates structured educational UX while keeping the dependable assessment path understandable.

title: Boot Inspector
description: Turns synthetic boot diagnostic records into an interactive report for reviewing startup events and likely investigation areas. It demonstrates diagnostic presentation while clearly avoiding claims of direct access to the visitor’s machine.

title: Folder Archaeologist
description: Explores a filtered file inventory through a readable report built from local or synthetic samples. It demonstrates how large directory information can be reduced into reviewable structure without uploading private files.

title: LAN Map
description: Visualizes a read-only network topology report with its local-network limits stated directly. It demonstrates topology communication and responsible handling of network-scan expectations.

title: WiFi Heatmap
description: Models a local wireless survey as a simulated coverage heatmap. It demonstrates spatial data visualization and survey interpretation without presenting sample measurements as a live scan.

title: Energy Monitor
description: Maintains a local appliance-energy ledger with readable totals, summaries, and trends. It demonstrates practical electrical data organization for understanding consumption patterns.

title: Component Vault
description: Provides an offline component reference organized for quick practical lookup. It demonstrates electronics knowledge organization and resilient access without a required remote service.

title: Resistor Vision
description: Combines a manual resistor color-code calculator with a compact reference workflow. It demonstrates dependable input-to-value calculation and accessible electronics guidance.

title: PCB Component Finder
description: Provides a manual annotation workspace for exploring and identifying PCB components. It demonstrates visual technical documentation while keeping identification decisions under user control.

title: Signal Lab
description: Presents a signal-analysis workflow behind its own controlled sign-in surface. It demonstrates electronics-focused analysis and deliberate access boundaries for a hosted tool.

title: Motor Toolbox
description: Collects engineering calculators for motor and electrical scenarios in one report-oriented interface. It demonstrates repeatable calculation workflows that make assumptions and results easier to review.

title: Machine Logbook
description: Provides a local-first maintenance logbook with documentation-oriented views. It demonstrates structured maintenance history and practical record keeping without making a remote account mandatory.

title: Screen Explainer
description: Supports privacy-first local image exploration and annotation. It demonstrates how screenshots can become clearer technical evidence while keeping image handling close to the user.

title: Diagram Script
description: Generates validated technical flowcharts through an offline workflow. It demonstrates reproducible diagramming and validation rather than relying on manually redrawn process maps.

title: Tech Calc
description: Groups reusable technical calculators and engineering helpers into a focused library. It demonstrates consistent input handling and repeatable calculation support across common scenarios.

title: Mini Tool Factory
description: Provides a controlled workspace for defining and using small calculators. It demonstrates reusable tool configuration while keeping calculator behavior explicit and reviewable.

title: Command Center
description: Combines portable dashboard views with browser-local preferences. It demonstrates configurable personal tooling that remains useful without a centralized profile service.

title: Storage Forensics
description: Presents a read-only storage inventory for structured review. It demonstrates forensic-style reporting while clearly separating report exploration from direct access to a visitor’s disks.

title: Privacy Inspector
description: Organizes a masked, read-only privacy review into an inspectable report. It demonstrates privacy-aware presentation and avoids exposing sensitive sample values unnecessarily.

title: Repo Time Machine
description: Turns Git history and repository metadata into a read-only timeline. It demonstrates software-change traceability and makes project evolution easier to inspect.

title: Project Digital Twin
description: Maps a technical project’s architecture into a read-only view of components and relationships. It demonstrates systems thinking, documentation discipline, and maintainability-focused tooling.

title: USB Device Historian
description: Reviews USB device history locally because meaningful analysis requires operating-system records, hardware context, and user-granted permissions. It demonstrates the engineering judgment to keep hardware-dependent inspection outside a misleading hosted demo.

title: Portfolio & Content Studio
description: Combines a fast static portfolio with a GitHub-backed Content Studio and automated publishing pipeline. It demonstrates dependency-free front-end engineering, secure OAuth boundaries, and maintainable content automation.
